reset.title: Reset app
reset.description: Clear all local settings and data on this device. This action cannot be undone.
reset.confirmDescription: This will permanently delete all account books, transactions, settlements, and settings stored on this device. Are you sure?

step1.title: Choose your language
step1.description: Pick the language you'd like to use in DuoJi. You can change it later in Settings.

step2.title: Set up your profile
step2.description: Tell us your name and email so account books and splits know who you are.
step2.cannotSkip: A valid name and email are required to continue.
step2.createFailed: Couldn't save your profile. Please try again.

step3.title: Create your first account book
step3.description: An account book groups your transactions. This step cannot be skipped — let's create one to continue.
step3.cannotSkip: Create an account book to continue.

step4.title: Edit your account book
step4.description: Need to change the name or currency later? Open the highlighted area to update the basics anytime.

step5.title: Add members
step5.description: Bring in the people you share expenses with so splits and settlements work seamlessly.

step6.title: Manage categories
step6.description: Default categories are ready to go. Tap here to add, rename, reorder, or remove them to fit your habits.

step7.title: Record a transaction
step7.description: Tap the highlighted button to record your first transaction.

sub1.title: Open the new transaction form
sub1.description: Tap the highlighted button to start recording a transaction.

sub2.title: Enter the amount
sub2.description: Type how much was spent. The total drives the per-person split.

sub3.title: Pick a category
sub3.description: Choose what this spending was for. Tap Next when you're ready.

sub4.title: Set who paid
sub4.description: Select the person who paid. You can split the payment across multiple people later.

sub5.title: Set the split
sub5.description: Choose who shares the cost. Equal split is applied by default.

sub6.title: Save the transaction
sub6.description: Tap Create to save your first transaction.

step8.title: Split with friends
step8.description: Settle balances and view who owes whom on the settlement page.

step9.title: View reports
step9.description: Filter by time range to see how money moves across categories.
